Training

How you can train

From the center’s own photos on Google and from what members write in their reviews.

Gym

A wide variety of modern equipment, strength machines, bikes and cross trainers. Members write that the equipment is modern and in excellent condition.

Swimming pool

An outdoor pool with swimming lanes next to the building. The swimming pool comes up in 4 reviews.

Martial arts

A hall with mats and punching bags for martial arts. Muay Thai comes up in 4 reviews, and members praise the martial arts instructor.
